name: Defaults To Patch Baseline
description: An account's default for one operating system in one region names its patch baseline (default -> baseline): the DescribePatchBaselines row whose DefaultBaseline is true, matched to the baseline's natural key, an AWS-owned baseline's ARN or the account's own pb- id (ruling Q139a option 2). A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM baseline walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_baselines.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-baselines).
